class.name: Box3DPhysicsDirectBodyState3D
class.brief_description: Direct body state provided by the Box3D physics backend.
class.description: Implements [PhysicsDirectBodyState3D] for Box3D bodies. The inherited body-state API is used by [PhysicsServer3D] and [RigidBody3D] force integration. Follow the lifetime and physics-step requirements of [PhysicsDirectBodyState3D].
